metadata.title: Open Market Note #001 — NEM Duration Baseline
metadata.description:
13-month empirical baseline for scarcity pricing duration ($300/MWh) and 8h BESS charging availability in Mainland Australia NEM (NSW1, QLD1, SA1, VIC1).

Package contains documentation (README.md), parameter ledger (PARAMS.md), reproducible python code, summary results (results.json), figures, data manifest (data_manifest.json).

Source Data Attribution: Australian Energy Market Operator (AEMO) Data Terms (https://aemo.com.au/privacy-and-legal/copyright-permissions)
